name: Menu map text
notes: Over the menu map's Green Meadow: one line at the bottom middle of the screen, in the thin gold info letters (font_info, drawn as sprites). While a garden item's message is queued (msg_q / msg_i) it shows that message: 'HP UP! MAX HP +5 (n/5)' or 'POWER UP! POWER +2% (n/5)' (+1% for the 2nd and 4th POWER UP). Otherwise, by the CLASSIC or the open WAVES sign (near 1) it shows BEST TIME and that run's best time (--:-- if never won), and by the locked WAVES sign (near 2) how many monster types are still to free (8 MONSTER TYPES LEFT ... 1 MONSTER TYPE LEFT, from 'unlocked'). Outside the Meadow the map HUD (hud_map) takes its place.
